method.sourceWrites: Authenticated /api/admin/source-wikis with codex/session provenance; existing ready entries rewritten only after snapshot and version check.
method.companyWrites: Authenticated POST /api/companies/:id/wiki, followed by Markdown readback. Compiles stored company facts; no claim of independently refreshing every corporate fact.
method.citationIndex: Guarded content-only PostgreSQL transaction synchronized PinSource with current sourceUrl and PinReference, removed obsolete associations and acknowledged existing researched summaries. Before/after changes recorded in AdminAudit. Used to avoid the general table API after-write listener, which would invoke source fetching and model-driven pin rewrites. No application code, deployment, restart, resize or build.
method.sharedSources: ERCOT, EIA, CAISO, MISO and SPP entries preserve raw field labels and separate status, dates, MW, MWh, AC/DC and shared facilities. EIA earlier source coverage retained. NYISO Alcazar requests indexed separately.
method.evidence: Saved primary documents, fresh direct source reads, local browser export, OCR of scanned PDFs and web-reader retries. Source-specific selected coverage is explicitly labeled.
method.verification: Read current pin and /sources for every scoped pin in both environments. Exact current link-set comparison, ready/nonempty wiki checks, zero stale summaries, unchanged title/description/long summary/references/source/author/company/date/confidence/media/price.

limitations: Four exact cited URLs lack substantive retrievable source content; left pending with specific research reasons.
Wiki coverage is scoped to citations of the corrected live pins in the saved backfill reports, not every untouched Cleanview lead or the whole database.
Source wikis index selected verified facts; long reports and portfolio pages are not claimed to be comprehensively summarized.
